column1: # Menu-specific caption sources from the local Steam PE 53.16.
# These fields use Adventure item action rules and typed material, creature,
# inventory and contaminant parsers; they are not global UI label aliases.
# Ordinary chooser categories use virtual +8; categories 3/6/7 use +16.
# Fill/ingest: type-3 contaminant, amount>=100, phase!=2, material!=target
# prepends each STATE_ADJ. Target type6 independently adds stagnant/salt
# (designation bits30/31), then STATE_NAME. Each field can include an HF
# possessive and RAW NAME_PREFIX. Invalid material yields unknown material.
# phase1 or phase0/type73 selects Drink; other phases select Eat. Unit
# location uses BP singular/plural, falling back to body part/body parts;
# item location is the whole c65450 designation. Null fields emit no text.
# RAW singular is only appended with a non-sentinel origin; invalid RAW
# with a location leaves the article plus two spaces before the bracket.
# Heat skips its entire near-source suffix when no magma/fire branch
# matches. The direction is independently optional through origin -30000.
